description: Hacker News search (stories and comments). Search Hacker News stories or comments by keyword, newest or most relevant first, with points, comment count, author, URL and HN link. Good for tracking mentions of a product, company or topic. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"q":"x402","count":1,"hits":[{"title":"...","url":"...","points":12,"comments":3,"author":"pg","createdAt":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","hn":"https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=1"}]}. Price: $0.0024 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: social_hn
